NEW TO THE GAME

What the game is & how to play

New to Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival? Here is what kind of game it is, how a run fits together and the habits worth building in the first hours.

Guide deskUpdated October 11, 20263 min read

An orientation, not a walkthrough. Objective routes live in the walkthrough guide and the linked sources.

On this pageWhat is Hellraiser: Revival?How a run fits togetherWeapons and the Genesis ConfigurationHabits for the first session

What is Hellraiser: Revival?

A single-player horror adventure set in Clive Barker’s universe, developed by Boss Team Games and published by Saber Interactive. You play as Aidan, searching for Sunny through the Labyrinth — a shifting, hostile otherworld — on PC and PS5.

How a run fits together

  1. Follow the named objectives in your menu rather than hunting for chapter numbers.
  2. Explore side rooms for codes, keys and crafting materials before moving on.
  3. Solve locks and puzzle boxes to open new routes; hints come before solutions on this site.
  4. Keep manual saves in different slots — there is no chapter select or post-story free roam.

Weapons and the Genesis Configuration

Combat mixes an arsenal of earthly weapons with the supernatural abilities of the Genesis Configuration, the puzzle box at the center of the story. Firearms are limited and worth tracking — the collectibles guide includes a saved checklist of all five.

Habits for the first session

  1. Pick the difficulty you enjoy; no trophy is reported to require a specific one.
  2. Enter locker and safe codes with leading zeroes included.
  3. Save before shops — launch builds reported tracking problems with the buying and selling trophies on PS5.
  4. When a room looks familiar, the walkthrough guide explains the opening loop.
